Coolify.notes: Deploy panel some users run (PANEL=coolify). Not installed by server-prep; the operator updates it from the panel.

Dokploy.notes: Deploy panel (PANEL=dokploy). Not installed by server-prep.

Openship.notes: Deploy panel (PANEL=openship). Not installed by server-prep.

Docker Engine.notes: docker step installs Docker CE from download.docker.com; unattended-upgrades includes origin Docker, so updates arrive automatically.

containerd.notes: Comes with Docker CE (containerd.io), auto-updated with Docker's origin.

runc.notes: Comes with containerd.io, auto-updated with Docker's origin.

CrowdSec.notes: ips step installs crowdsec + firewall bouncer from packagecloud.io (pinned 900). NOT auto-updated by unattended-upgrades (see issue #155).

cloudflared.notes: Optional cloudflared step, pkg.cloudflare.com. NOT auto-updated.

Tailscale.notes: server-preconfig.sh installs it with tailscale.com/install.sh (pkgs.tailscale.com repo). NOT auto-updated unless the operator enables it.

Telegraf.notes: Optional telegraf step, repos.influxdata.com (pinned 900). NOT auto-updated.

OpenSSH.notes: Hardened by the ssh step. Distro package: unattended-upgrades installs the fix, the service restarts.

sudo.notes: Distro package; Ubuntu 26.04 uses sudo-rs instead. unattended-upgrades installs the fix.

sudo-rs.notes: Default sudo on Ubuntu 26.04. Distro package, unattended-upgrades.

Linux kernel.notes: unattended-upgrades installs kernel fixes but a reboot is needed; the audit shows sys.reboot WARN.

ufw-docker.notes: Script downloaded by the firewall step at a pinned version with a SHA-256 (UFW_DOCKER_VERSION / UFW_DOCKER_SHA256 in server-prep.sh).

glibc.notes: Distro package: unattended-upgrades installs the fix within a day (security pocket); a service restart or a reboot may be needed.
